phases.name: Year 1
phases.subtitle: Explore
phases.description: Economic & Business Foundations — Build economic reasoning and business literacy for applied economics careers.

milestones.label: Complete CliftonStrengths assessment and business economics career mapping
milestones.description: Complete the Gallup CliftonStrengths assessment and connect signature themes to business economics career pathways including corporate strategy, management consulting, market research, and business analytics.

milestones.label: Master principles of microeconomics
milestones.description: Study consumer behavior, market structures, pricing theory, and resource allocation. Students analyze how individuals and firms make decisions under scarcity using supply and demand models.

milestones.label: Master principles of macroeconomics
milestones.description: Examine national income, monetary and fiscal policy, inflation, unemployment, and economic growth with a focus on how macroeconomic conditions shape business strategy and corporate decision-making.

milestones.label: Join Economics Club or business student organization
milestones.description: Join a CoBE-affiliated organization such as the Economics Club, Enactus, or a business fraternity. Attend networking events and participate in business case discussions.

milestones.label: Analyze global business environments
milestones.description: Examine how international trade, exchange rates, and global economic institutions shape business environments across countries and regions.

phases.name: Year 2
phases.subtitle: Engage
phases.description: Intermediate Economics & Business Core — Integrate economic theory with core business disciplines.

milestones.label: Complete intermediate microeconomic theory
milestones.description: Advanced consumer and producer theory, game theory, market failures, and business strategy applications. Students develop mathematical models of firm behavior and competitive dynamics.

milestones.label: Master managerial accounting for business economics
milestones.description: Cost analysis, budgeting, and managerial decision-making tools essential for economists working in corporate environments. Students connect economic theory to internal business financial analysis.

milestones.label: Attend CoBE career fair and consulting firm events
milestones.description: Participate in career fairs and recruiting events targeting consulting firms, corporate strategy roles, and business analytics positions. Practice case interview fundamentals.

milestones.label: Apply marketing analytics to business economics
milestones.description: Integrate marketing principles with economic analysis, focusing on market research, consumer demand estimation, pricing strategies, and competitive positioning in local and global markets.

phases.name: Year 3
phases.subtitle: Develop
phases.description: Applied Business Economics & Professional Experience — Master quantitative methods and gain industry experience.

milestones.label: Master econometric methods for business
milestones.description: Regression analysis, forecasting, and causal inference methods applied to business problems. Students use econometric tools to analyze market trends, demand forecasting, and business performance data.

milestones.label: Study managerial economics and strategy
milestones.description: Apply microeconomic theory to managerial decision-making including optimal pricing, production decisions, market entry strategy, and competitive analysis in oligopolistic industries.

milestones.label: Secure and engage with an industry mentor
milestones.description: Establish a mentorship with a business economist or strategy consultant through the CoBE Alumni Mentor Network. Monthly meetings focus on industry insights and career development.

milestones.label: Complete summer business economics internship
milestones.description: Secure and complete an internship in corporate strategy, management consulting, market research, or business analytics. Apply economic analysis skills to real business challenges.

milestones.label: Analyze industrial organization and competition policy
milestones.description: Study market power, antitrust policy, regulation, and competitive dynamics using game theory and empirical methods. Analyze mergers, acquisitions, and competitive strategy in domestic and global markets.

phases.name: Year 4
phases.subtitle: Launch
phases.description: Career Placement & Capstone — Finalize professional readiness, complete capstone project, and launch business economics career.

milestones.label: Execute capstone business economics project
milestones.description: Complete a comprehensive applied research project analyzing a real business economics problem. Deliver strategic recommendations using econometric analysis to faculty and industry panelists.

milestones.label: Complete salary negotiation and offer evaluation training
milestones.description: Participate in negotiation workshops covering compensation analysis and offer evaluation for consulting, corporate strategy, and analytics roles. Develop personal compensation strategy.

milestones.label: Serve as peer mentor for underclassmen
milestones.description: Mentor underclassmen in economics and business coursework. Facilitate study groups and share career development insights from internship and professional experiences.

milestones.label: Develop industry-specific placement portfolio
milestones.description: Assemble a career launch package targeting consulting, corporate strategy, or analytics positions. Includes case interview preparation, tailored resume, and documented industry contact network.

milestones.label: Complete exit assessment and career activation
milestones.description: Complete the CoBE Economics Exit Assessment and finalize career activation documenting job offers, graduate admissions, or professional placement status.
